text: {"findings": [{"option_id": "c3.r1a1", "rule_id": "sql-serverless-auto-pause", "reason": "The serverless alternative enables auto-pause after 1 hour idle, so the first connection after a quiet period waits up to about a minute for the database to resume, which conflicts with a business-hours user base that needs prompt responses."}, {"option_id": "c4.r1a1", "rule_id": "redis-premium-only-features", "reason": "Requirements do not rule out persistence or clustering, and the replacement is Standard C1, which lacks data persistence, clustering and VNet injection that the Premium P1 today may be using."}]}
